title: What I learned from tracking one trading process for 7 months
author: Silent_Mango_4703
selftext:
​

Most trading strategies look impressive for a few winning weeks.

The real question is: can the same process stay consistent over months and across different market conditions?

I’ve been tracking a strategy called Falcon for the past 7 months. It is designed to be used with both:

• Prop firm accounts

• Live trading accounts

Falcon focuses on structured entries, risk control, and avoiding unnecessary overtrading. It is not about chasing every market move or relying on random signals.

No exaggerated promises.

No “get rich quick” claims.

Just test the process, review it yourself, and decide based on your own experience.

Trading involves risk. A 7-month track record does not guarantee future results. Use proper risk management and follow your prop firm’s rules.
